definitions.gloss: without; excluding; leaving out (as a suffix)
definitions.explanation: Used as a suffix attached to a noun to mean "without that thing" or "with that thing removed." Extremely common in food ordering, daily conversation, and written instructions.
The act of leaving something out or cutting corners in a process or task. Often used in the expression {手抜|てぬ}き (cutting corners, doing a sloppy job).

examples.japanese: わさび{抜|ぬ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧{抜|ぬ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I went out without having breakfast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧{抜|ぬ}きで、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
examples.english: Joking aside, this is a serious problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧{抜|ぬ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}しなかった→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧だろう。
examples.english: Without him, this project probably wouldn't have succeeded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手抜|てぬ}き→手抜き：07724_tenuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
⟦{手抜|てぬ}き→手抜き：07724_tenuki⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美味|おい}しく→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Even shortcuts cooking can turn out surprisingly delicious.

notes:
Derived from the verb ⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧ (to pull out, remove). As a suffix, {抜|ぬ}き attaches directly to a noun: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧ → X{抜|ぬ}き (without X). This is one of the most practical suffix patterns for daily life in Japan, especially when ordering food.

Sense 1 ("without") is extremely common. Learners will encounter it constantly at restaurants (わさび{抜|ぬ}き, ⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧{抜|ぬ}き) and in everyday expressions like ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧{抜|ぬ}き (joking aside) and ⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧{抜|ぬ}き (skipping breakfast).

Sense 2 relates to the compound ⟦{手抜|てぬ}き→手抜き：07724_tenuki⟧, which is itself a very common word meaning "cutting corners" or "being sloppy."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- わさび{抜|ぬ}き: without wasabi
- ⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧{抜|ぬ}き: without ice
- ⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧{抜|ぬ}き: skipping breakfast
- ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧{抜|ぬ}き: joking aside
- ⟦{手抜|てぬ}き→手抜き：07724_tenuki⟧: cutting corners, sloppy work
- ⟦{手抜|てぬ}き→手抜き：07724_tenuki⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: quick-and-easy cooking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- なし: without, none — a more general word; {抜|ぬ}き implies active removal
- ⟦{除|のぞ}く→除く：02391_nozoku⟧: to exclude — a verb form; {抜|ぬ}き is used as a compact suffix
- ⟦{無|な}し→無し：03779_nashi⟧: without — often interchangeable in food orders, but {抜|ぬ}き emphasizes "take it out"
